prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a fully designed desktop web application Home screen for Mazi, signed-in shared memory archive for 8 friends. Landscape 1536x1024, straight-on screen capture, no device mockup or presentation annotations. This is an operational memory-browsing interface, never a marketing landing page. Persistent readable navigation: mazi / Home active / Timeline / Search / My Imports / one small group avatar. Synthetic photo content of friends: Mediterranean terrace dinner at dusk, rainy city walks, a lake swim, picnic and birthday table. Selected memory title exactly 'The night we missed the last ferry', metadata 'Summer 2024 · 18 photos · Added by Deniz', visible 'Open memory' action. Small 'Demo memories' label. Design must feel warm and human through large unfiltered full-color photography even where the surrounding system is abstract. No fake metrics, testimonials, public share/publish/privacy controls, likes, AI summaries, notifications, ornamental technology charts, microscopic necessary text, or generic rounded-card dashboard. Every control usable and beautifully spaced. Exceptionally ambitious bespoke studio-quality application design.
STRUCTURE AND WORLD: OUR PANORAMA. Black-green background #171A18, warm white #F5F0E7, one emphatic coral #EB7856 action color. Monumental lightweight lowercase typographic 'summer / 2024' forms a left-aligned two-line anchor in upper-left quarter. An asymmetric strict square-module panorama of large PHOTO TILES spans the entire center and right, extending suggestively toward a visible next-pane arrow at far right without clipping essential controls. Main dinner photograph occupies a 2x2 tile area, adjacent ferry image 1x2, two small photographs 1x1. Under main tile its selected title and metadata; Open memory is a flat CORAL typographic rectangular tile with white arrow. Tiles have crisp corners, no gradient or cards. One selected tile shows a slight physical hinged angle and a visible thin side edge, implying it turns open into its memory, while the rest stay flat. Real 3D depth is concentrated in this single hinged tile, not a general tilted dashboard. Bottom left a spare aligned 'Recently added' strip with three event titles and tiny thumbnails. Giant type but no commercial slogan, no illegible text, no arbitrary extra panels. Visually daring warm photographic panorama with a strong design grid.
